Triage: **`pm:queue`** (objectui in-repo card — pm-state only, no domain label per whole-repo-seat protocol).

**Classification rationale**: concrete defect with named anchors, all re-verified live on objectui `origin/main` @ `523be48`:
- `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx` `Field` wrapper renders `Label htmlFor={id}` (verified, ~:447);
- `Field id="widget-color"` at :377 wraps `ColorVariantPicker`, whose props are exactly `{ value, onChange, disabled, options }` (`color-variant-field.tsx:43-48`) — no id/aria channel, so the `for` IDREF is dangling as described;
- the picker's `div role="radiogroup"` (`color-variant-field.tsx:54`) carries neither `aria-label` nor `aria-labelledby` — the group is unnamed;
- not dormant: unconditional branch of every dashboard-widget inspector render; sibling consumer sites confirmed at `PageBlockInspector.tsx:438` and `widgets.tsx:1790` (card asks the implementer to audit those two for the same unowned-label shape — kept in scope as written).

**Fix-fork judgment**: the option 1 vs 2 fork (add `ariaLabelledBy` channel vs self-owned `ariaLabel`) is implementation-layer, not decision-box — `Field` is a file-local helper and `ColorVariantPicker` an internal app-shell component, not a published authoring surface; PR #4012 already establishes the same class of naming-channel prop addition on `InspectorComboField`. Filer's lean toward option 1 (IDREF naming, #3990/PR #4002 pattern) recorded as the recommended direction.

**Dedup**: repo-scoped searches (`ColorVariantPicker`, `widget-color`) return only this card; draft PR #4012 (the #3997 fix) explicitly excludes this scope and cross-links here — no `Blocked-by:` needed, #4012 does not touch `ColorVariantPicker`.

**`target:v17`**: judgment referred to the objectui whole-repo seat (its board, its producer).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

【PM 分诊】objectui 分片(session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt):晋级 `pm:queue`,待循环恢复后派发(当前额度受限暂停派发)。

具体缺陷两半都成立:`widget-color` 的 `for` 悬空(ColorVariantPicker 不收 id)+ `div role="radiogroup"` 本身无可访问名(组内 radio 各有 aria-label 不能替代组名)。修法参照 #3997/PR #4012 的机制:要么 ColorVariantPicker 收 id 落到 radiogroup 元素 + `aria-labelledby` 指回 Label,要么组上直接 `aria-label` —— 实施时按该组件其它调用点的形态定,一并把 radiogroup 命名钉进 #3994 定型的那组测试形状。

另采纳 PR #4012 回传的方法论提示:**宽面 sweep(18 处清单)若恢复,检索式必须补「有 `for` 但解析不到宿主」的悬空 IDREF 扫描** —— `grep Label | grep -v htmlFor` 按构造漏掉本单这一类反向缺陷。此提示已记入本评论供 sweep 分诊引用。
